product_one_liner.value: Aurora Solar provides software for solar companies and sales teams to design, sell, and permit solar projects.
product_one_liner.notes: Aurora's homepage says solar organizations, ranging from two-person sales teams to national dealers, use its platform to design, sell, and permit solar. Source: https://aurorasolar.com/

pricing_page.notes: Aurora has a public pricing page displaying plans and prices, including its Basic plan. Source: https://www.aurorasolar.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Aurora publishes customer case studies describing CertainTeed selecting its platform and Solaris Renewables using it for design, sales, engineering, and installation workflows. Sources: https://resources.aurorasolar.com/certainteed-case-study and https://resources.aurorasolar.com/solaris-case-study | named_customers.0: The CertainTeed customer case study describes selecting Aurora after evaluating software options. Source: https://resources.aurorasolar.com/certainteed-case-study | named_customers.1: The Solaris Renewables case study describes Aurora providing the company's software platform. Source: https://resources.aurorasolar.com/solaris-case-study

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 299 employees, which falls within the required 201–500 band. Source: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/53aa2f92e4b028b38bdd905e/aurora%20solar#a:about

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Aurora's press release explicitly states that the company is headquartered in San Francisco. Source: https://aurorasolar.com/news/aurora-solar-adds-integrated-storage-modeling-to-helioscope-uniting-commercial-solar-design-storage-and-financial-analysis-in-one-solution | hq_country: The company profile places Aurora Solar in San Francisco, California, United States. Source: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/53aa2f92e4b028b38bdd905e/aurora%20solar#a:about

founded_year.notes: Aurora's company history explicitly states that it was founded in August 2013. Source: https://www.aurorasolar.com/about

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying posts are authored by Senior Computer Vision Engineer Adriel Luo: 'How AI helped speed up our AI' discusses the AI SmartRoof deep-learning pipeline and its optimization, while 'GANs vs. Diffusion Models: Putting AI to the test' discusses model experiments, training data, and Aurora's roof-modeling pipeline. Sources: https://aurorasolar.com/blog/ai-helped-speed-up-our-ai and https://aurorasolar.com/blog/putting-ai-to-the-test-generative-adversarial-networks-vs-diffusion-models

public_docs.notes: Aurora's public documentation includes multiple tutorials, including creating a project, retrieving an AHJ name, and receiving project-sale notifications, alongside an API reference. Sources: https://docs.aurorasolar.com/docs and https://docs.aurorasolar.com/reference

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The unfiltered careers board lists software engineering, business systems, product marketing, analytics engineering, and account executive positions, but no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. Staff Analytics Engineer is excluded by the question's definition. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/aurorasolar

model_provider.notes: Aurora publicly lists OpenAI and Anthropic as AI-service subprocessors for Engineering. This identifies providers, but not particular model versions or the features using each provider. Source: https://trust.aurorasolar.com/subprocessors

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center names SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, and PCI DSS—SAQ A 4.0. Source: https://trust.aurorasolar.com/compliance | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly names SOC 2 Type 2. Source: https://trust.aurorasolar.com/compliance | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center explicitly names GDPR. Source: https://trust.aurorasolar.com/compliance | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center explicitly names PCI DSS—SAQ A 4.0. Source: https://trust.aurorasolar.com/compliance

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest-round profile identifies Series D, matching Aurora's funding announcement. Sources: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/53aa2f92e4b028b38bdd905e/aurora%20solar#a:about and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/climate-tech-saas-leader-aurora-solar-secures-200-million-in-series-d-to-further-the-digital-transformation-of-the-solar-ecosystem-301491593.html | funding_date: The latest-round profile and Aurora's announcement give February 28, 2022, normalized to 2022-02. raised_18mo.notes: The most recent recorded funding round was announced on February 28, 2022, before the eighteen-month window beginning in May 2025. Sources: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/53aa2f92e4b028b38bdd905e/aurora%20solar#a:about and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/climate-tech-saas-leader-aurora-solar-secures-200-million-in-series-d-to-further-the-digital-transformation-of-the-solar-ecosystem-301491593.html

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers board lists a Mid-Market Account Executive position, and its posting provides an application link. Sources: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/aurorasolar and https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/aurorasolar/cc3cf270-c536-4856-ae38-53a26fc0e3d8

launched_6mo.notes: On September 22, 2026, Aurora announced major platform updates, including live heat-pump modeling for eligible German installers. This falls within the six-month window. Source: https://aurorasolar.com/news/aurora-solar-expands-beyond-solar

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. Aurora's About page did not provide a complete executive roster with start dates. A profile gives Charlie Herche's CEO start only as November 2025, while reporting published in October 2025 already describes the CEO transition. An exact change within the requested twelve-month window could not be established. Sources: https://aurorasolar.com/about, https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/aurora-solar-ceo, and https://www.sfexaminer.com/news/technology/struggling-sf-solar-company-cuts-more-staff-names-new-ceo/article_11301de8-2e8a-4dcc-a1ab-f2ac19f731d8.html
